name: festival
about: Six pocket nodes (Pi Zero 2 W with a LoRa HAT, on power banks) spread over a festival field 400 m across: their built-in WiFi doesn't reach each other, so everything goes by radio; every radio hears every other, so there are no hidden terminals, and the question is airtime. A lost-child alert at 21:00, then a burst as the headline act ends.

events.text: Lost child, red jacket, about 6, last seen near the stage
